description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LegoMachine"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Start building"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_HandOverSets" name="Hand over Lego sets to children"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_SortParts" name="Children sort parts into containers"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Build_Merge" name="Subcomponent build needed"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent using parts from containers"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Parts_Remain" name="Container has parts?" default="Flow_PartsEmpty"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Test_Merge" name="Subcomponent ready for test"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent individually"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllTests_Check" name="All tests successful?" default="Flow_TestFailed"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_RebuildSubcomponent" name="Rebuild subcomponent"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble subcomponents"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Machine" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignDone" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetsOrdered" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="ManualTask_HandOverSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetsHandedOver" sourceRef="ManualTask_HandOverSets" targetRef="ManualTask_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsSorted" sourceRef="ManualTask_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reordered" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildStart" sourceRef="Gateway_Build_Merge" targetRef="ManualTask_BuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Built" sourceRef="ManualTask_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_Parts_Remain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsAvailable" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Remain" targetRef="Gateway_Test_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${containerHasParts}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsEmpty" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Parts_Remain" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rebuilt" sourceRef="ManualTask_RebuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_Test_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestStart" sourceRef="Gateway_Test_Merge" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tested" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_AllTests_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestPassed" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllTests_Check" targetRef="ManualTask_AssembleSubcomponents">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allTestsSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllTests_Check" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesigned" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="ManualTask_RebuildSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assembled" sourceRef="ManualTask_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_Machine"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
